raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "sphinxcontrib-details-directive" %}
{% set version = "0.1.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 78bd6a67f786a21868abf0e6a5973340d7e7a6fd71b1890de9c856f92877b38b

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - sphinx >=2.0
    # uses pkg_resources
    - setuptools

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - sphinxcontrib  
    - sphinxcontrib.details
    - sphinxcontrib.details.directive

about: 
  home: https://github.com/tk0miya/sphinxcontrib-details-directive
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_family: Apache
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: 'A sphinx extension adding the details directive'
  description: |
    It enables details directive as an element to represent <details> element 
    in HTML output. It will be converted into mere paragraphs in other output 
    formats.
  dev_url: https://github.com/tk0miya/sphinxcontrib-details-directive

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/sphinx
    - astamminger
    - chrisjsewell
